layout_map: Dark matrix/code-rain background full-bleed. A dim, near-silhouette hooded figure sits in the LEFT third (cells 1,5,9; face center ~x150,y160) with a glowing 'fsociety' wordmark plate over his chest at ~x130,y170. Headline occupies the right two-thirds in stacked rows: bright yellow 'TURN' top-right (cells 3-4, baseline ~y70, all-caps), white 'INTO' mid (cell 7, baseline ~y150), small yellow 'A' beside it (cell 8, ~x290,y150), then a large grunge-distressed white 'HACKER' across the bottom-right (cells 11-12, baseline ~y190, all-caps). Yellow is the accent word color; HACKER is the textured payoff word.
why_it_works: The dim hacker silhouette plus glowing 'fsociety' tag sets an ominous mood while the bold yellow-on-black command 'TURN INTO A HACKER' promises transformation.
mimic_for: an aspirational 'become X' transformation promise where a moody subject sits left and a bold command-style headline fills the right
title: This will make you a Hacker!!!

layout_map: Vertical 50/50 split. LEFT half: a green Pepe-style frog character hunched at a laptop on a toilet, lit normally (cell 5-6-9-10 region, character center ~x180,y260). RIGHT half: a sickly blue-tinted distressed version of the same character at a messy multi-monitor desk, red-vignette danger lighting (cells 7-8-11-12, center ~x950,y260). Top row carries the comparison label: white 'LEVEL 0' top-left (cells 1-2, baseline ~y45, caps) and white 'LEVEL ∞' top-right (cells 3-4, baseline ~y45, caps) with a curved red arrow sweeping between them across the top-center (~x560-680,y40) pointing left→right.
why_it_works: A meme-format before/after of the same character (chill noob vs deranged grind god) with the red arrow makes the absurd 0-to-infinity escalation instantly legible and funny.
mimic_for: a humorous progression/escalation beat — beginner versus obsessed expert, same subject transformed, low-stakes meme energy
title: From SCRIPT KIDDIE to PRO HACKER.

layout_map: Dark code-stream background. A dimly lit man's face (Mr-Robot-style, hand near mouth) sits in the LEFT third behind a slight scanline overlay (cells 1,5,9; face center ~x190,y200). Right two-thirds hold a three-row stacked headline, all-caps, right-aligned: white 'HACK' top (cells 3-4, baseline ~y90), red accent 'ANY' middle (cell 7-8, baseline ~y200) as the colored payoff word, white 'WiFi' bottom (cells 11-12, baseline ~y300). Thin glitch/scanline texture across the type.
why_it_works: The moody hacker face plus the stark white-red-white 'HACK ANY WiFi' stack reads as a forbidden how-to in one glance — 'ANY' in red is the dangerous promise.
mimic_for: a how-to / capability claim with a danger edge — moody subject left, three-word stacked headline right with the middle word colored as the hook
title: Hack Any Wifi in 3 minutes.

layout_map: 640x480 frame, red-on-black circuit/lightning background. A hooded Anonymous Guy-Fawkes-mask figure with glowing red eyes is centered low (cells 10-11-14-15, mask center ~x320,y330, filling the lower-center). Top-left a pair of hands holds up a smartphone with a glowing red rear camera (cells 1-2-5-6, phone ~x130,y90). Right side carries a stacked headline: red 'HACKING' (cells 3-4, baseline ~y50, caps), purple/blue 'PHONE' (cell 8, baseline ~y110, caps), red 'CAMERA' (cell 8-area, baseline ~y160, caps). Heavy red danger glow throughout.
why_it_works: The anonymous mask with red eyes plus a phone showing its camera lit red triggers an invasion-of-privacy fear — your own camera weaponized against you.
mimic_for: a privacy/security-threat beat — a menacing anonymous figure and a familiar device shown compromised, red danger palette
title: How Phone Cameras Are Hacked???

layout_map: Dark teal grid/tech background. A stylized scowling Wolverine-style illustrated face fills the LEFT third (cells 1,5,9; face center ~x180,y230, intense glare). Right two-thirds hold a three-row right-aligned stacked headline, all-caps bold: orange-red 'NEVER' top (cells 3-4, baseline ~y90), white 'STOP' middle (cells 7-8, baseline ~y190), large orange-red 'CODING' bottom (cells 11-12, baseline ~y300). Orange-red is the dominant accent on the first and last words; white middle word breaks the rhythm.
why_it_works: The aggressive Wolverine glare plus the imperative 'NEVER STOP CODING' channels grind-culture intensity — pure motivational dare energy.
mimic_for: a motivational / grind-mindset call to action — an intense character left, a three-word imperative stacked right with outer words colored hot
title: Warning: This Video Will Make You Code All Night.

layout_map: Dark circuit/world-map background with red danger glow. A single huge red distressed 'HACKED' headline spans the top, all-caps, centered (cells 1-4, baseline ~y95). Below sits a row of three large app logos: Facebook 'f' on the left (cell 9-13 area, ~x150,y360), a glowing red-tinted Instagram camera icon centered and largest (cells 14-15, ~x320,y360), and a red TikTok note icon on the right (cell 12-16 area, ~x550,y360). All logos washed in the same red hostile tint to read as compromised.
why_it_works: Recognizable social logos rendered in alarm-red under a bleeding 'HACKED' headline makes the threat personal — these are the accounts you actually use.
mimic_for: a beat about multiple familiar platforms/tools all affected by one thing — a logo row under a single big alarm word
title: How social media accounts get HACKED???
